SELECT COALESCE(SUM(telescope_count), 0) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) FROM telescopes) AS average_share,
         COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
)
WHERE share > average_share
